description:
**Company Description**
 Anton Paar develops, produces and distributes highly accurate laboratory instruments and process measuring systems, and provides custom\-tailored automation and robotic solutions. It is the world leader in the measurement of density, concentration and CO2 and in the field of rheometry.
   

  

 At Anton Paar India, we are responsible for the distribution process, including sales, service, customer and application support, and logistics.
   

  

 You may visit our website for more information at http://www.anton\-paar.com/
   

  

 Also, you may like to have a glimpse about the culture at Anton Paar India at https://www.anton\-paar.com/in\-en/jobs/corporations/working\-at\-anton\-paar\-india\-pvt\-ltd/
   

  

**Job Description**
 The
 **Product Specialist** 
 serves as the technical and product expert for an assigned portfolio of Anton Paar instruments, supporting customers and the Sales team through technical consultation, product demonstrations, application support and training.
   

  

 The role works closely with Sales, Service, Marketing and Global Product Management to understand customer requirements, recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions and support the growth of the assigned product portfolio.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
**Sales \& Pre\-Sales Support**
* Provide technical and application support to the Sales team and customers during the pre\-sales process.
* Conduct product demonstrations, feasibility studies, sample analyses and technical presentations.
* Support technical proposals and customer discussions and work with Sales teams to identify and develop business opportunities.
* Support and track the sales funnel for assigned product lines.


**Product \& Customer Support**
* Deliver product, installation and application training to customers and internal teams.
* Provide technical support for method development, troubleshooting and instrument optimization.
* Collaborate with the Service team to resolve complex technical issues and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Gather customer feedback and application requirements to support continuous improvement.


**Market \& Product Development**
* Support marketing campaigns, seminars, exhibitions and other product\-promotion activities.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market trends and technological developments relevant to the assigned product portfolio.
* Develop application notes, case studies and other technical content to strengthen product positioning.
* Support new product launches, including demonstration readiness, internal training and customer engagement.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong technical aptitude and scientific understanding, with the ability to translate customer requirements into appropriate solutions.
* Strong customer orientation with good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation and customer\-interaction skills.
* Ability to conduct effective product demonstrations and explain complex technical concepts in a clear and practical manner.
* Commercial awareness and ability to identify and support potential business opportunities.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across Sales, Service, Marketing and global teams.
* Self\-driven, organized and able to manage multiple customer and product\-related priorities.
* Willingness to travel extensively based on business requirements.


**Education \& Experience**
* Ph.D., Master's or Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Physics, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology or a related scientific/technical discipline.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in scientific instrumentation, analytical measurements, technical sales or application support.
* Hands\-on experience with analytical instruments, with a good understanding of measurement principles, data analysis and scientific methodologies.
* Experience in customer\-facing technical roles, product demonstrations, application development or customer training would be preferred.
* Experience within the scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment or analytical instrumentation industry would be an advantage.

The Program Deployment Analyst will independently manage stakeholder alignment, deployment wave planning, site readiness, training, adoption, risks, and benefits tracking for assigned workstreams to ensure the program delivers measurable improvements in productivity, compliance, data quality, and manufacturing loss reduction.

* Opportunity to drive deployment of a global manufacturing digital transformation agenda across Ecolab plants as a senior individual contributor.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong program delivery skills with a track record of independently delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives against schedule, quality, adoption, and business impact expectations.
* Experience with manufacturing excellence, TPM, HPN, Lean, Six Sigma, loss elimination, OEE / OPE / OLE, productivity, material loss, first\-pass quality, or related manufacturing KPIs.
* Experience deploying digital manufacturing tools, paperless workflows, automation, data visualization, AI use cases, or manufacturing control tower solutions.
* Familiarity with EKODE, eQMS, ERP, EBS, EPM, Power BI, workflow automation, OCR, barcode / QR code scanning, or machine vision technologies.

description:

 Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since.

 Johnson Controls Digital Solutions is looking for an experienced engineer with a deep knowledge on building technologies including BMS, VMS, and Access Control etc.
